items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, telemetry, deployments, dependencies, or requeues this cycle. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate commission is not site-attributable; site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift remain unknown. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls and $890.42 cost. Infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs; approved budget ceilings; and learning thresholds are absent, so budget exposure and cost-to-learn are not calculable. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation, preserving explicit unknowns and rejecting vanity metrics as financial evidence.

Handoff: retain the existing measurement and attribution reconciliation work only. Do not create finance proposals or duplicate telemetry. Reconcile provider revenue, AI cost, and other recorded costs for matching periods; retain aggregate provider rows as unattributed; do not treat clicks, impressions, sessions, rankings, orders, shipped items, AI calls, or pilot output as margin or ROI evidence.
